type.description: The stable category URI. Switch on this, never on `title`.

bearerAuth.description: A `telmoni_` API token, minted on the Keys page. The token IS the organization; there is no second credential and no scope below the organization.

info.description: The API a `telmoni_` token opens. Every response that is not a success is an RFC 9457 problem document, and a client switches on its `type` rather than on its prose.
info.title: Telmoni API

get.description: Everyone on the project the key was minted on, the owner first, with the role each holds. The same body the console's project roster shows, so a key reads no more than the project admin who minted it could; the organization's roster is the console's alone.

200.description: The members: the owner, then the project's seats.

401.description: No live `telmoni_` API key was presented. A revoked, expired or unknown key answers the same way.

429.description: Too many requests. The server meters by source address and by key before the request reaches a lane, and says when to come back in `Retry-After`.

503.description: The lane is switched off, or something it needs did not answer. A switched-off lane says when to try again in `Retry-After`.

get.description: The organization the key belongs to — its id, its slug, its name and its owner's address and name. The slug is what the console's URLs name it by: set from the name it was created under, when that reads as one, and moved only when the URL is changed in Settings; the id never moves. A key IS an organization, so this answers for the caller and for nobody else.
